subject: general
question: What was the unemployment rate in India for individuals aged 15 years and above from July 2023 to June 2024?
solution:
The correct answer is __**3,2%**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The** unemployment rate in India for people aged 15 and above from July 2023 to June 2024** was 3.2%. 
 
• This rate **remained unchanged from the previous year, despite a five-year decline. **
 
• **The unemployment rate is the percentage of people in the labor force **who are unemployed. 
 
• The Periodic Labour Force Survey (PLFS) is the source of this data. 
 
• The PLFS for the period July 2023 to June 2024 was released by the Labour Bureau on September 23, 2024. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Unemployment rate in India**
 
• **In March 2022, the unemployment rate in India was 8.28% in urban areas. **
 
• **In January 2023, the unemployment rate in India was 7.14%. **
 
• **In January 2022, the unemployment rate in India was 6.57%. **
 
• **In December 2022, the unemployment rate in India was 8.3%**
